messages:
Jana Patel: Noticed a big latency spike on /v1/chat for redwood-chat-ggml around 11:40 PDT. p99 jumped to ~2s. Grafana shows prefix cache hit-rate collapsed.
SRE-bot: [ALERT] model=redwood-chat-ggml latency_p99=1.98s baseline=0.28s. Dash: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-cache
Miguel Santos: Any recent rollouts that touch batching or cache? Could be config drift.
Priya Rao: I flipped on a new batching heuristic (dynamic_window) on rg-12 at 11:35 (commit f3a9c2). I did not change cache settings intentionally.
Arun Bhattacharya: Dynamic_window changes packing density. Profiler showing a spike in kv ops and many kernel-select fallbacks — seems related.
Priya Rao: Paste of rollout fragment:
Priya Rao: ```
model: redwood-chat-ggml
prefix_cache:
  enabled: true
  max_bytes: 1GB
  eviction_policy: lru
batching:
  dynamic_window: true
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```
Arun Bhattacharya: Profiler (11:36-11:40):
```
kv_prefix_hit_rate{model="redwood-chat-ggml"} 0.10
kv_prefix_evictions_total 130k -> 980k
batcher_inflight_tokens 12k -> 48k
kernel_select_fallback_count 0 -> 900
worker_cpu% 76
```
Mei Chen: Also saw heavy long-context reranking from tenant-xyz on rg-12 starting 11:34 (seq len ~8k). Large KV entries and their sizes can blow out the cache quickly.
Miguel Santos: That matches: average KV entry size jumped ~3.8x. With a 1GB budget and LRU, working set got evicted rapidly -> hit-rate collapse.
Priya Rao: I should have scaled cache when enabling denser packing. Missed that in rollout checklist.
SRE-bot: Recommended mitigations queued:
1) rollback dynamic_window on rg-12 (in progress)
2) temporarily increase prefix_cache.max_bytes -> 4GB on affected nodes
3) throttle tenant-xyz long-context requests
4) implement admission control for oversized prefix entries (post-incident)
Jana Patel: Rolling back dynamic_window now. @Arun watch kernel selector fallout — fallback to slower kernels will affect latency.
Arun Bhattacharya: Confirmed kernel selector hit an untested codepath due to new chunk shapes; it picked FP32 fallback kernels in multiple shards. I'll add a prefer-quantized override and guard rails.
Mei Chen: After rollback + cache bump + tenant throttle, kv_prefix_hit_rate climbed back to ~88-90% within ~3 minutes and p99 fell to ~300ms.
Priya Rao: I'll submit a PR updating the rollout checklist: require cache-sizing check when enabling dynamic batching and add an automated preflight simulating worst-case KV sizes.
Miguel Santos: Action items: (A) Priya: checklist PR, (B) Arun: admission control + kernel selector guard, (C) SRE: alert on kv_prefix_eviction_rate > 0.5%/min to preempt. Will create JIRA tickets.
Jana Patel: Good containment. Postmortem: add runbook step to correlate tenant long-context activity before packing heuristic rollouts. Schedule short retro.
SRE-bot: Incident closed. :white_check_mark:
